abstract: Intrapulmonary teratoma (IPT) is exceedingly rare, hence preoperative diagnose is usually inaccurate. A 21-year-old man was presented with a 5-year history of recurrent hemoptysis and left upper lung mass with heterogeneous opacity on chest x-ray. Diagnostic fibrobronchoscopy detected tuft of brownish hairs in the left upper anterior segmental bronchus, achieving the diagnosis of IPT preoperatively, which was further confirmed by lobectomy. The case report is noteworthy with fibrobronchoscopic finding of endobronchial hairs in a heterogeneous lesion, which underscores the important role of fibrobronchoscopy in the differential diagnoses of chronic cavitary lesions such as IPT without trichoptysis.
abstract_ja: 肺内奇形腫(IPT)は極めて稀であり、術前診断は通常不正確である。21歳男性が、5年間の反復する喀血と、胸部X線で不均一な陰影を伴う左上肺腫瘤を主訴に受診した。診断目的の気管支鏡検査で、左上葉前区域気管支に褐色の毛髪束が認められ、術前にIPTの診断に至り、肺葉切除術で確定した。本症例報告で注目すべきは、不均一な病変内の気管支内毛髪を気管支鏡で確認した点であり、毛髪喀出のない慢性空洞性病変(IPTなど)の鑑別診断における気管支鏡検査の重要な役割を示している。
